title: Chapter 312 Destiny Is On My Side
content:
Chapter 312 Destiny Is On My Side

Looking at Lu Xue in front of him, Chu Lingsheng said, "If you break through to the Immortal Saint Realm, you can deal with Chen Mingyu."

"but,,"

Chu Lingsheng paused, touched his chin and chuckled, "Are you sure you can break through then?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue struggled to get up, clenched her fist and said, "I'm sure."

"I don't believe it."

......

Lu Xue wanted to say something, but Chu Lingsheng waved his hand.

"Don't use those illusory things to fool me. The bronze palace is indeed tempting, but I cherish my life even more. Unless, when you really reach the Immortal Saint Realm, I can deal with Chen Mingyu with you."

Anyway, it won't work now.

At this time, Lu Xue and others also understood what Chu Lingsheng meant.

Among them, no one is Lu Xue or Chu Lingsheng, who can pose a threat to Chen Mingyu.

If you insist on going to the Bronze Palace in this way, you are seeking death.

Immediately, Chu Lingsheng left.

A gust of cold wind blew, and Chu Lingsheng disappeared directly from everyone's sight.

In the cave, Lu Xue and others were speechless for a long time.

Their strength is still too weak.

This is just the 19th place on the Monster List. If you meet someone with the Monster List, then won’t you be dead at that time?

"Sister Xue, then we?"

Xiao Luo stepped forward and asked hesitantly.

Lu Xue looked gloomy, "Chen Mingyu, I must kill him!"

And at this moment, Lu Xue was suddenly stunned.

Not only Lu Xue, but also Xiao Luo and Qin Feng beside him.

The next moment, the three of them took out a small and exquisite token at the same time.

It is the identity token of Tiandi Academy.

At this moment, the token is trembling slightly.

......

"Huh? In addition to us, there are other academy students in this ancient battlefield."

Tang Hao stood in front of the crowd, looking at the token in his hand and said suspiciously.

He just wanted to give it a try, but he didn't expect that there would be a real response.

As both students of Tiandi Academy, as long as they have tokens, they can sense their mutual position.

"Brother Hao, then do we want to find them?"

A student from the academy asked.

At this moment, the first team of more than a dozen people was only seven people left shortly after entering the ancient battlefield.

Ye Yandongku and others on the list of monsters have long since left the team.

There are only six people who are willing to follow Tang Hao now.

Hearing this, Tang Hao pondered for a moment and said, "No need, they are in the depths of the ancient battlefield, just go in directly."

"I'll agree first. If you lose it, don't blame me for not saving you if you encounter any danger."

After saying that, Tang Hao directly used his ghostly body technique to gallop towards the depths of the ancient battlefield.

But obviously, he still intentionally lowered his speed.

But even so, it was difficult for the six people behind him to follow.

On the other side.

"That's great, Sister Xue, it seems that many people in our academy have entered the ancient battlefield."

"Although we don't know what's going on, we have reinforcements at least."

Qin Feng said excitedly at this time.

He believed that those who dared to enter the ancient battlefield at this time were definitely not ordinary people.

Among them, there must be someone who can deal with Chen Mingyu.

Even if not, it is not impossible to beat Chen Mingyu in groups.

Hearing this, Lu Xue pondered slightly.

Although she also wants to take revenge with her own strength, it is obviously difficult to do so far.

Since you can fight together, why bother to fight alone?

"Okay, then let's go and meet them."

Immediately, the three of them went in one direction directly according to the sensing of the token of the Tiandi Academy.

At the same time, somewhere in the ancient battlefield.

A broken ruin, as a terrifying force gradually disappeared, a simple young man not far away in front of him showed a victory smile.

"Young master is a good person!"

An old man suddenly rushed out and shouted.

Upon hearing this, the young man did not react at all, but walked forward lightly.

"The will of the ancient strong man, that's it?"

The young man was obviously a little disdainful, but as soon as he finished speaking, the scene suddenly began to buzz.

The next moment, a vague figure slowly emerged.

"Boy, don't be so arrogant. If it weren't for the fact that I had little power left in the battle back then, just by you,

boom!

Before the phantom could finish his words, the young man punched him out.

It was not over yet. He took out another disc and spoke softly.

"town."

As soon as the words fell, the scene calmed down again.

"Young master, your decision is indeed not wrong. Fortunately, you didn't escape immediately, otherwise you would have really missed this ancient battlefield feast."

The old man smiled and walked forward.

And at this moment, a crisp sound of footsteps suddenly came from a distance.

The young man was slightly stunned and suddenly looked at the sound.

They have set up a ban, so why can anyone come in?

From a distance, I saw a handsome man walking slowly towards here with a steady pace.

Seeing the appearance of the man in front of him, the young man couldn't help but frown slightly.

There is actually someone in this world who is so handsome.

"Who is your Excellency?"

The visitor is naturally Lu Daosheng.

"Don't be nervous, I have no malice. I just want to tell you that the biggest opportunities in the ancient battlefield are all in the bronze palace on the ancient battlefield."

Lu Daosheng spoke directly as soon as he got up.

Hearing this, the young man frowned even deeper.

"Your Excellency wants to lead me to the Bronze Palace, probably for some other purpose."

Of course, he would not directly believe Lu Daosheng who suddenly appeared.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng shook his head slightly, with a faint smile on his face.

I saw Lu Daosheng pointing his index finger at the man far away, and said directly: "Ye Wuwei, maybe, are you the one with destiny?"

Lu Daosheng's voice was not loud, but at this moment, it kept bombarding Ye Wuwei's mind like the sound of the great way.

The word "The Destiny of a Person" keeps echoing in his ears.

At the same time, an indescribable aura flew out from Lu Daosheng's index finger and entered Ye Wuwei's body.

The next moment, Ye Wuwei was stunned on the spot.

At this moment, he only felt that his body had reached an unprecedented spirit.

The mysterious man in front of him not only expressed his name, but also told him that he was a destined person.

The unfathomable methods made Ye Wuwei believe it in his heart.

"Former, senior,"

However, when Ye Wuwei came to his senses, Lu Daosheng had already disappeared from the spot.

"Young Master, what's wrong with you?"

At this time, the old man next to him suddenly said in confusion.

Upon hearing this, Ye Wuwei suddenly looked at the old man beside him, "You, didn't you see it just now?"

"Huh? Young Master, what are you talking about?"

Suddenly, Ye Wuwei took a breath.

He was sure that what he had just done was definitely not an illusion.

At this moment, he still felt his body's excitement.

I met a mysterious boss, and I am actually a destiny person!

In an instant, Ye Wuwei suddenly burst into laughter and kept shouting.

"Destiny is with me!"
